heard: An invisible dead star is devouring a fast-spinning giant star. Astronomers long believed Gamma Cass EOP was just a solitary giant. This massive star spins so fast it flings out gas. For decades, powerful X-rays from the system defied explanation. Observations by the X-Rism space telescope finally solved the mystery. An Earth-sized white dwarf companion orbits inside that gas disk. The X-rays flare as the white dwarf consumes the stellar material. Apollo astronauts nicknamed this star Navi for Gus Grissom in 1967. In the constellation Cassiopeia, this hidden companion consumes its neighbor.
differences: 'cassiopeiae' heard as 'cass eop' after 'long believed gamma'
